import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# Read the MSD data

time = data[:, 0]  # Time in ps

# Perform linear regression to get the slope
# We'll use the linear region (typically after initial transient)
# Let's skip the first few points and use the rest
skip_points = 10  # Skip first 10 points to avoid initial transient
time_fit = time[skip_points:]
msd_fit = msd[skip_points:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time_fit, msd_fit)

print(f"Linear fit results:")
print(f"Slope (d(MSD)/dt): {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Å²")
print(f"R² value: {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"Standard error: {std_err:.6f}")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = (1/6) * d(MSD)/dt
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # in Å²/ps

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"D = {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Å²/ps")

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Å²/ps = (1e-10)² / (1e-12) m²/s = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s
conversion_factor = 1e-8
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * conversion_factor
